Job Title: Trainer AI, Edge AI & Robotics

AI & Robotics Skilling Centers

Location

Kolkata, with travel as required

Reports to

Practice Head AI, Edge AI & Robotics

Type

Full-time


About the Role

We’re building a nationwide chain of AI & Robotics Skilling Centers and Makers Labs across India, built on a “Skilling to Incubating” model that takes learners from structured training into hands-on prototyping and, eventually, incubation. We’re looking for a Trainer to deliver this curriculum on the ground, teaching core concepts, hand-holding learners through mentored Makers Lab projects, and helping them build real, demonstrable skill rather than passive lecture notes. You’ll work closely with the Practice Head, who sets the curriculum and delivery standards you’ll bring to life in the classroom and lab.


Core Responsibilities Training Delivery

  • Deliver classroom, hybrid, and mentored Makers Lab sessions across assigned capability areas, which may include Edge AI Applications, Computer Vision, Multi-modal AI, Agentic AI, Cloud-based AI, Gen AI & LLMs, or Robotics, as per the curriculum defined by the Practice Head.
  • Hand-hold learners through mentored, hands-on projects rather than deliver lecture-only content, helping candidates move from concept to working prototype.
  • Adapt teaching pace and depth to a mixed pool of learners, ensuring learners with different starting points all reach the required competency bar.
  • Track learner progress, flag gaps early, and provide the extra support or remediation needed to keep learners on pace.

Curriculum Execution & Feedback

  • Deliver the curriculum, tooling, and project briefs as designed, while flagging outdated content, unclear briefs, or gaps observed during delivery back to the Practice Head.
  • Contribute ground-level inputs to keep course content and project briefs current.
  • Maintain session plans, learner assessments, and project documentation to the quality standards set for the network.

Center & Lab Operations

  • Maintain lab and classroom delivery quality in line with the standards set and audited by the Practice Head, so learner experience stays consistent across centers.
  • Use and help maintain GPU-based lab infrastructure and other technical setups needed for sessions.
  • Support onboarding of new trainers at the center where relevant, sharing delivery practices and classroom norms.

Industry Connect

  • Support Makers Lab and incubator-style projects tied to live industry briefs, working with learners to bring these projects to a demonstrable stage.
  • Represent the center credibly to visiting industry partners, guest experts, or academic visitors during sessions or demo days.

Requirements Must-have

  • Preferably 3+ years of hands-on industry or teaching experience in one or more of: Cloud AI, Edge AI, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Gen AI/LLMs, Agentic AI, or Robotics.
  • Comfort teaching or mentoring, explaining technical concepts clearly to learners at different skill levels.
  • Working fluency with current AI tooling relevant to the assigned capability area(s), not only foundational theory.
  • Willingness to work from a Skilling Center and travel occasionally as required.

Nice-to-have

  • Prior experience as a trainer, teaching assistant, bootcamp instructor, or corporate trainer.
  • Robotics-specific experience like robotic arm programming, mechanical or hardware design fundamentals.
  • Experience working with GPU-based lab infrastructure or similar technical lab setups.
  • Exposure to mentoring hackathon, capstone, or incubation-style projects.

You will play a pivotal role in designing, building, and scaling state-of-the-art Generative AI applications, advanced RAG pipelines, and autonomous Agentic AI workflows. Overview

Quickbase is seeking a Data Analyst, Operational Intelligence to support our Sales and Product-Led Growth analytics needs, with a particular focus on our Pave product. This role is part of our centralized Operational Intelligence team, working in close partnership with Data Engineering and Revenue Operations counterparts to ensure GTM teams have reliable, trusted data at their fingertips.

You will serve as an analytics partner for our Sales organization while also developing visibility into PLG signals, surfacing how product usage translates into trial conversion, expansion, and growth opportunities. The ideal candidate is a strong SQL practitioner who brings genuine curiosity about the business, thrives in a collaborative cross-functional environment, and has experience supporting operational teams and recurring business cadences in a globally distributed setting.

What You'll Do

Develop and maintain reports and dashboards that track core Sales and PLG KPIs, including trial conversion, product adoption, feature activation, and revenue performance

Serve as the Operational Intelligence team's analytics partner for Sales and Revenue Operations, translating business questions into reliable, actionable reporting

Build and maintain data models in Snowflake that support Sales and PLG analytics use cases for the Pave product

Collaborate closely with Data Engineering to align on modeling standards, data quality practices, and pipeline dependencies

Partner with Revenue Operations to ensure GTM metrics including free trial signups, time-to-activate, product qualified leads, trial conversion, and expansion signals are consistently defined and trusted across reporting

Support operating mechanisms including GTM business reviews, reporting cadences, and recurring operational processes where data accuracy and timeliness are critical

Identify trends in product usage and PLG motion that inform Sales strategy and prioritization

Enable self-service analytics by building reusable datasets and maintaining clear, accessible documentation

Ensure data quality and consistency across Sales and product analytics workflows

Support the Applied AI team by delivering the trusted datasets and semantic layer foundations that power reliable AI automation workflows and outputs

What You Bring

3 to 7 years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or GTM/sales analytics roles

Strong SQL skills with solid experience in data modeling and working with cloud data platforms, ideally Snowflake

Demonstrated experience supporting Sales, Revenue Operations, or GTM teams in a SaaS environment, including supporting business reviews and recurring reporting cadences

Strong understanding of how operational teams consume and act on data, not just how to model it

Solid understanding of PLG concepts, product usage analytics, and GTM metrics

Hands-on experience contributing to dbt projects, including writing models, tests, and documentation

Ability to define and standardize business metrics across stakeholder groups

Strong communication skills, able to present data clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Comfortable working cross-functionally in a globally distributed, async-friendly environment with some US business hours overlap

Experience with Power BI or comparable BI and data visualization tools

Experience with CRM data (Salesforce) and revenue analytics platforms

Familiarity with PLG tools or product analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or Pendo

Exposure to data governance and data quality frameworks

Experience working in a product-led or hybrid sales-led/PLG SaaS organization

Pave represents an exciting new growth motion for Quickbase, and this role is critical to making that motion data-driven from day one. Sales and Revenue Operations teams have reliable, consistent visibility into trial conversion, PLG signals, and expansion opportunities

PLG signals from Pave are systematically tracked and surfaced to inform Sales prioritization

Key GTM metrics are clearly defined, documented, and trusted across the organization

Operating mechanisms including GTM business reviews and reporting cadences are consistently supported with accurate, timely data

Self-service reporting adoption grows within Sales and Revenue Operations teams

Contributions to the central dbt model are well-tested, documented, and aligned with enterprise standards

Strong working relationships are established with Data Engineering and Revenue Operations counterparts

At Quickbase, we view AI as a tool to accelerate how work gets done not replace it. We encourage thoughtful use of AI to improve speed, quality, and decision-making, while maintaining strong judgment, accountability, and data integrity.

We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to design and build intelligent integrations that connect our clinical, business, and enterprise systems. This role combines traditional software engineering with modern AI and automation technologies to eliminate manual work, streamline business processes, and accelerate digital transformation.

You will build APIs, system integrations, AI-powered workflows, robotic process automation (RPA), browser automation, and data pipelines across cloud applications, EHRs, ERP systems, Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and other enterprise platforms. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving difficult integration problems and leveraging AI to automate repetitive business processes.


What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable REST APIs and backend services.
  • Build integrations between enterprise platforms using APIs, webhooks, HL7/FHIR, SFTP, file processing, and messaging technologies.
  • Develop AI-powered automation solutions using modern LLMs, AI agents, and workflow orchestration platforms.
  • Build robotic process automation (RPA) solutions for systems without modern APIs.
  • Develop browser automation solutions for web applications that cannot be integrated through APIs.
  • Create resilient automation workflows for interacting with legacy web portals, payer systems, provider portals, and other third-party applications.
  • Build data extraction, transformation, synchronization, and scraping solutions where appropriate and compliant.
  • Design event-driven architectures for reliable system-to-system communication.
  • Automate business workflows across clinical, operational, finance, and HR systems.
  • Build reusable integration frameworks and internal developer tooling.
  • Create monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational dashboards for integration health.
  • Optimize reliability, scalability, security, and performance of enterprise integrations.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to identify automation opportunities with measurable ROI.
  • Mentor junior engineers and establish engineering best practices.

Technologies You'll Work With

  • Python, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js
  • REST APIs, GraphQL, gRPC
  • SQL and NoSQL databases
  • AWS cloud services
  • Docker and Kubernetes
  • GitHub Actions / CI/CD
  • Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Graph
  • Salesforce APIs
  • HL7, FHIR, X12, and healthcare integration standards
  • Message queues and event streaming
  • OpenAI, Anthropic, and other LLM platforms
  • AI agent frameworks and orchestration tools
  • Browser automation frameworks including Playwright, Selenium, Puppeteer, and Microsoft Playwright
  • RPA platforms such as UiPath, Microsoft Power Automate, Automation Anywhere, or similar technologies
  • OCR and intelligent document processing technologies
  • Integration platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or custom middleware (preferred)

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Strong experience designing and building production APIs.
  • Extensive experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with browser automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or Puppeteer.
  • Experience building enterprise automation and RPA solutions.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud-native application architecture.
  • Experience with authentication protocols including OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, and JWT.
  • Experience with asynchronous processing and distributed systems.
  • Strong SQL and database design skills.
  • Excellent debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building AI agents and autonomous workflows.
  • Experience integrating healthcare applications and EHR systems.
  • Knowledge of HL7, FHIR, HIPAA, and healthcare security requirements.
  • Experience automating interactions with legacy enterprise applications and web portals.
  • Experience with OCR, computer vision, or intelligent document processing.
  • Experience building ETL and data engineering pipelines.
  • Familiarity with event-driven architectures and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience with observability platforms such as Datadog, Grafana, or CloudWatch.

Within your first year, you will:

  • Deliver enterprise integrations that eliminate significant manual effort.
  • Build AI-powered automations that improve operational efficiency across multiple departments.
  • Automate workflows across both API-enabled and legacy browser-based systems.
  • Create reusable integration and automation components that accelerate future development.
  • Improve reliability and visibility of critical business workflows.
  • Help establish engineering standards for APIs, browser automation, AI agents, and enterprise automation.

Ideal Candidate

You enjoy solving complex systems problems and have a builder's mindset. You're equally comfortable writing production APIs, integrating enterprise software, automating browser-based workflows, building AI agents, and deploying RPA solutions. You understand that many enterprise environments contain a mix of modern APIs and legacy applications, and you know how to build robust automation solutions across both.

descriptionFromApi:
Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to build production-grade algorithms for connected vehicles, EVs, and fleet systems.

This is not a dashboard-only analytics role. You will work with noisy field telemetry, CAN/OBD/J1939 signals, fault codes, battery and powertrain data, sensor behavior, and service outcomes. You will design algorithms that detect issues, predict failures, explain root causes, recommend action, and continuously improve as more vehicles come online.

You should be comfortable moving from messy data exploration to deployable models, from signal-level debugging to fleet-level insights, and from "interesting graph" to "customer can take action now."

What You'll Do

Build vehicle intelligence algorithms

Develop algorithms across areas such as fuel, EV battery health, diagnostics, driver behavior, and predictive maintenance. Example problem areas include:

  • Fuel theft, refill, drain, consumption, fill-rate detection, and fuel-sensor failure detection.
  • Fuel rail pressure, pumping efficiency, oil pressure, turbo-health, air-filter, coolant-temperature, and powertrain anomaly detection.
  • DEF efficiency, DPF health, air-intake-system performance, and after-treatment diagnostics.
  • Ambient-aware EV range prediction, battery SOH/SOC estimation, battery-pack temperature forecasting, and battery-swap readiness signals.
  • Driver-behavior scoring and fuel-efficiency impact attribution.
  • Fault-code aggregation, diagnostic-code sequencing, RCA, upstream failure analysis, and guided repair recommendations.

Own the full algorithm lifecycle

Take algorithms from data discovery to production. This includes data cleaning, signal validation, feature engineering, model development, offline evaluation, field validation, deployment, monitoring, drift detection, and iteration.

Work with real-world vehicle telemetry

Handle missing data, sensor noise, inconsistent calibration, vehicle variants, firmware differences, network gaps, and edge cases from field deployments.

Partner across teams

Work closely with firmware, hardware, validation, cloud, product, customer success, and field teams. You will use bench data, vehicle logs, service feedback, and customer reports to make algorithms reliable outside the lab.

Build explainable and actionable outputs

Translate model outputs into alerts, diagnostics, probable causes, recommended fixes, confidence levels, and fleet-level insights. The goal is not just prediction. The goal is useful action.

Must-Have Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in applied ML, data science, algorithm engineering, signal processing, or time-series analytics.
  • Strong Python skills, including NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, and production-quality data pipelines.
  • Experience with time-series data, anomaly detection, forecasting, classification, regression, rule-based systems, or hybrid ML plus heuristics.
  • Strong SQL and comfort working with large telemetry datasets.
  • Experience converting messy sensor data into robust features and measurable algorithms.
  • Ability to evaluate algorithms using precision, recall, false-positive rate, latency, confidence, coverage, and field impact.
  • Experience productionizing models or algorithms, not just building notebooks.
  • Strong debugging instincts and ability to reason from first principles.

Strongly Preferred

  • Automotive, EV, IoT, fleet, industrial, or embedded-systems data experience.
  • Familiarity with CAN, OBD-II, J1939, UDS, DTCs, ECUs, telematics devices, or vehicle logs.
  • Experience with EV battery systems, BMS data, SOC/SOH estimation, thermal models, or range prediction.
  • Experience with diesel/powertrain systems such as DPF, DEF, turbo, fuel rail, oil pressure, coolant temperature, and air intake.
  • Experience with streaming data, Kafka/Flink/Spark, Airflow, data lakes, or real-time analytics.
  • Exposure to online learning, reinforcement learning, auto-calibration, Bayesian methods, Kalman filters, survival models, causal inference, graph-based diagnostics, or sequence models.
  • Ability to build simple internal tools, dashboards, notebooks, or scripts for validation and debugging.

Good-to-Have

  • Experience deploying algorithms to edge devices or constrained environments.
  • Experience working with firmware and hardware teams.
  • Knowledge of MLOps, model monitoring, experiment tracking, and model governance.
  • Rust, Go, or systems-programming exposure.
  • Prior work in predictive maintenance, remote diagnostics, fleet intelligence, insurance telematics, energy analytics, or connected vehicle platforms.

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days: Understand Bytebeam's telemetry schema, vehicle signal sources, customer use cases, and current alerting/diagnostics stack. Identify the first 2 to 3 high-value algorithms to build or improve.

First 90 days: Ship one validated algorithm into pilot use, with clear metrics, alert definitions, dashboards, and field feedback loops.

First 6 months: Own a small portfolio of production algorithms across vehicle health, diagnostics, fuel/energy, or EV battery intelligence. Reduce false positives, improve diagnostic accuracy, and create reusable algorithm frameworks for future use cases.

Ideal Candidate

You are a builder who can speak both ML and machines. You enjoy data, but you do not hide inside notebooks. You can sit with a field log, a firmware engineer, a DTC sequence, and a customer complaint, then emerge with an algorithm that actually helps someone fix a vehicle faster.

You care about precision, but also about practicality. You know that the best algorithm is not always the fanciest one. Sometimes it is a calibrated rule, sometimes a state machine, sometimes a tree model, sometimes a forecast.

Reporting to our CTO, you'll own the complete data lifecycle, from ingestion and transformation through deployment and observability, while defining infrastructure standards for a growing engineering team.

descriptionFromApi:
THE ROLE
This role sits between the people who need something and the people who build it. You will own discovery, requirements and delivery rhythm for AI features across our internal AI intelligence layer, our internal operating platform and client engagements, with product leadership setting direction and you running the execution.
AI product work differs from standard product work in one important way: the output is probabilistic. A feature is not simply built or not built, it is built to a quality level that has to be defined, measured and defended. A good part of this job is making that definition concrete enough for an engineer to build against and an executive to sign off on.
WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Run discovery with internal teams across operations, finance, HR, creative and PMO to find where AI genuinely removes work rather than adding a layer over it.
- Write product requirement documents that engineers can build from without a follow up meeting, including acceptance criteria that account for model behaviour rather than assuming deterministic output.
- Own and prioritise the backlog for AI features across both internal platforms, and run sprint ceremonies for the pod.
- Define and track adoption and impact metrics. If a feature ships and nobody uses it, that is yours to surface and fix.
- Support client engagements with requirement gathering, scope documentation and stakeholder communication.
- Coordinate user acceptance testing, rollout, internal enablement and documentation.
WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
- Three or more years in product ownership, business analysis or a comparable delivery role, with at least one year on technically substantial products.
- Genuinely strong written communication. A large share of this job is documents, and they need to be unambiguous.
- A working understanding of how LLM products behave, including why they fail and what that means for scoping. You do not need to build them, but you cannot treat them as a black box that either works or does not.
- Confidence with stakeholders more senior than you, including the ability to say a request is not feasible and explain why.
- Comfort with ambiguity. Requirements here often begin as a vague complaint about a process.
USEFUL BUT NOT ESSENTIAL
- Agile or Scrum certification, particularly CSPO.
- Experience with internal platform or enterprise tooling products, where adoption is the hardest problem.
- Exposure to AI governance, data privacy or access control requirements.
- Basic SQL, enough to answer your own questions about usage data.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE
In your first ninety days you will own the delivery cycle for one product area end to end, and establish an adoption measurement baseline that did not exist before you arrived.

Company Overview

At FoodChain ID, we are driven by our vision to make it easier to keep the food supply chain safe and transparent. As a global leader in food safety, compliance, and product innovation solutions, we support more than 30,000 companies across more than 100 countries with a comprehensive software platform that enables leading food manufacturers and retailers to manage compliance, risk, and efficiently access new markets and consumers as the New Food Economy continues to evolve.

Job Title: Business Analyst and Product Commercialization Lead

Reports To: Director, Product and Delivery Enablement

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full Time

Job Overview

The Business Analyst and Product Commercialization Lead works as part of the Product Management team supporting FoodChain IDs Enterprise Solutions portfolio, which includes Formulation for PLM, Compliance Analysis, and Recipes & Specifications. The role covers the two stretches of work that sit on either side of development: getting work ready to build, and getting built work ready to deliver.

On the front end, the role develops the epics, features, user stories, and acceptance criteria that carry an idea into a development-ready state, working day to day with the Product Management team, which sets feature scope and prioritization. Doing this well means understanding the product domain deeply enough to write requirements engineering can build from without a second round of clarification.

On the back end, the role makes sure that what development delivers is ready for customers: owning release communication, producing and maintaining product documentation, and building the training and services enablement assets that Services, Support, and Sales need to put new functionality to work. Consistent use of AI tooling is expected, including building and refining agent skills that reduce the manual effort of keeping documentation and release content current as features ship.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Definition and Development Readiness

- Develop epics, features, and user stories from product direction, customer input, and conversations with subject matter experts (SMEs), working under the direction of the Product Management team, which owns feature scope and prioritization.

- Author clear, testable acceptance criteria, and confirm shared understanding with engineering and QA before work is committed to a sprint.

- Conduct the upfront research and analysis that makes story-writing and refinement sessions productive, so that decisions rest on evidence.

- Work closely with SMEs, Services, and business partners to understand the product needs behind a request, and translate them into requirements a development team can build from.

- Review or create process and system flow maps documenting the business domain, including the business rules and logic needed to incorporate a process into the system.

- Identify and document story dependencies to support refinement and sequencing.

- Maintain a regular cadence for story definition, writing, review, and refinement, keeping a backlog of sufficient depth and readiness to support team velocity.

- Participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, and demos as the analyst closest to the requirements.

Delivery Coordination

- Track development progress against committed plans so that commercialization work is timed to when functionality will land.

- Raise scope changes, emerging gaps, and at-risk dates to the Product Management team early, with the specifics needed to make a decision.

- Review delivered functionality against acceptance criteria before it is considered ready for customers, and flag discrepancies.

- Contribute delivery and release content to the recurring account reporting and business reviews prepared by product leadership.

Release Communication

- Own release communication end to end: build and operate a repeatable process that captures release content as it is developed.

- Write release notes for every release, translating technical changes into language customers can act on, and publish them on a predictable cadence.

- Brief Services, Support, and Sales ahead of customer-visible changes so that internal teams are never behind the customer.

- Coordinate the timing of release communication with documentation and enablement updates so that customers and internal teams encounter a consistent picture.

Product Documentation

- Own the customer documentation portal as its primary author and editor, and keep published content aligned with shipped functionality.

- Drive documentation updates from the same source that drives release notes, so that both are produced from one pass through each release.

- Improve the structure and quality of existing documentation over time, prioritizing the areas where support escalations and customer questions indicate confusion.

- Establish and maintain standards for voice, structure, and depth so that content stays consistent as contributors change.

Training and Services Enablement

- Develop the training and enablement assets that accompany newly delivered functionality, including written guides, walkthroughs, and reference material for customer and internal audiences.

- Build the baseline materials, templates, and content standards that the Services team adapts and delivers for customer-specific training.

- Deliver internal enablement sessions for Services, Support, and Sales as significant functionality ships.

- Use support escalation and defect trends to identify where documentation or training gaps are generating avoidable customer friction, and close those gaps.

Implementation Templates and Standards

- Support the implementation templatization program led by the Director, Product and Delivery Enablement, which builds the out-of-the-box configuration, data, and documentation starting point that Services and customers deploy from.

- Own the documentation and content components of the standard package, and deliver assigned tasks within the program plan.

Launch Readiness and Adoption

- Maintain a launch readiness standard for customer-visible functionality, confirming that documentation, training assets, internal enablement, and release communication are complete before a release reaches customers.

- Track adoption of newly released functionality and report on it, so that the value of what we ship is visible.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year

- Stories and acceptance criteria reach development ready to build, with clarification cycles the exception rather than the norm.

- Release notes publish on a predictable cadence for every release, and published documentation matches shipped functionality.

- No significant functionality reaches customers without documentation, training assets, and internal enablement in place.

- Services and Support are equipped to deliver customer training from materials they did not have to build themselves.

- Adoption of newly released functionality is measured and reported on a regular cadence.

Required Qualifications

- Three or more years of experience in business analysis, product management, product commercialization, or a comparable role on a software product team.

- Two or more years as a member of an Agile team, ideally as a Business Analyst, Product Owner, or Scrum Master.

- Demonstrated experience authoring user stories and acceptance criteria that a development team built from.

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders and SMEs, and translating their needs into development-ready requirements.

- Demonstrated experience producing customer-facing content, such as product documentation, release notes, user guides, or training material.

- Strong written communication, with the range to write for developers, executives, and customers and adjust register accordingly.

- Working knowledge of the software development lifecycle and of Agile and Kanban practices.

- Proficiency with development planning tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, and Confluence.

- Comfortable using AI tools to draft, review, and maintain content.

- Comfortable working with product usage or support data to produce straightforward adoption and quality reporting.

- Professional, customer-facing communication style, with the poise to lead a working session or enablement session.

Preferred Qualifications

The Manager, Information Technology - Encounters IT is a technology leader and visionary responsible for driving modernization, scalability, and innovation across the Encounter Management ecosystem. This role leads a cross-functional engineering team delivering encounter processing capabilities while advancing cloud adoption, modern architecture patterns, and enterprise transformation initiatives.

This position owns the end-to-end technology strategy for encounter processing platforms, ensuring reliability, compliance, and performance, while partnering closely with EDI, integration, and business teams for seamless data exchange and regulatory submission. The role focuses on transforming legacy encounter processes into scalable, cloud-enabled, and automation-driven platforms.

Technology Strategy & Transformation

  • Define and execute a multi-year technology roadmap for Encounters IT aligned with enterprise digital and modernization strategy
  • Lead cloud adoption (Azure/AWS), microservices, API-first, and event-driven architecture initiatives across encounter platforms

At SNHU, youll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.

The Market Research and Insights Analyst uses research and analysis to help university leaders understand what is changing in higher education, why it matters, and what we should pay attention to next. As part of the Marketing Insights and Analytics team, you will explore internal and external data, secondary research, competitive intelligence, and market signals to uncover meaningful trends and emerging questions.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys following evidence, discovering unexpected patterns, asking "why," and communicating the story behind the data-not simply producing reports. #LI-Remote

Market Research

  • Monitor and review industry literature and research publications, and maintain a system to curate publications, competitive intelligence, and internal research/reports.
  • Create landscape summaries of topics relevant to higher education and update with new data and insights on an ongoing basis.
  • Use third-party platforms and public datasets to investigate markets, programs, populations, competitors, and opportunities.
  • Partner with Product Marketing and other teams to investigate new programs, markets, audiences, and strategic questions, including providing data support for program portfolio reviews and new program proposals.
  • Conduct deep-dive ad hoc research on market and competitive trends.

Analysis and Insights Development

  • Build, maintain, and update data models and reports of external data sources (e.g., IPEDS), using tools such as Microsoft Fabric/PowerBI.
  • Use existing data models and reports to monitor and summarize internal performance trends across products, segments, and demographics.
  • Enhance reports and dashboards according to feedback, insights, and institutional goals.
  • Actively seek opportunities to improve and anticipate feedback on analytic projects and tools.
  • Present analysis findings to diverse audiences in multiple formats.
  • Use project management software to keep track of multiple priorities and projects.
  • Other duties and responsibilities, as assigned.

What were looking for:

  • 3+ Years of professional experience in market research
  • Bachelors degree in Marketing, Analytics or similar field
  • Experience analyzing information, developing meaningful insights, and communicating findings to a variety of audiences.
  • Familiarity with US higher education industry terms and data sources
  • Can build and update models and reports in Fabric/PowerBI including intermediate proficiency with DAX and PowerQuery
  • Proficiency in Excel with the ability to perform lookups and mathematical formulas.
  • Experience developing and delivering PowerPoint presentations to a wide variety of audiences from executives to individual contributors.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Outlook, and project management software.
  • Keen attention to detail, accuracy, and validation of data
  • Can responsibly leverage Artificial Intelligence for workflows, summarization, and analysis.

We believe real innovation comes from inclusion - where different experiences, perspectives and talents are celebrated. So if youre wondering whether SNHU is right for you, take the leap and apply. You might be just the person were looking for.

Compensation

The annual pay range for this position is $64,283.00 - $102,872.00. Actual offer will be based on skills, qualifications, experience and internal equity, in addition to relevant business considerations. We expect this position to be hired in the following target hiring range $71,033.00 - $96,103.00.

Exceptional benefits (because you re exceptional)

You re the whole package. Your benefits should be, too. As a full-time employee at SNHU, you ll get:

  • High-quality, low-deductible medical insurance

  • Low to no-cost dental and vision plans

  • 5 weeks of paid time off (plus almost a dozen paid holidays)

  • Employer-funded retirement

  • Free tuition program

  • Parental leave

  • Mental health and wellbeing resources

jobDescription:
Role Overview

The Implementation Project Manager works with new and existing customers to onboard Revinate s entire product suite and provide long-term success. The role is the small-scale project manager for new customer implementations, product upsells, and Statement of Work requests. The selected candidate will work with internal and external contacts to onboard new customers, track the status of project deliverables, work with external vendors to facilitate integrations, make sure that technical aspects of the product are working correctly, resolve real-time technical issues, and ensure all projects are completed efficiently and on time.

A blend of project and stakeholder management, customer-facing communication, and masterful cross-department collaboration, the ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, quickly adapts to new technology, and can manage simultaneous projects with varying deadlines.

Please take note of the shift for this position. This role will be covering Central European working hours. Typically running from 1:00 PM IST - 9:30 PM IST, Monday - Friday. This role is supporting customers based in EMEA and APAC.

All applicants and candidates must be willing to interface with team members in North American European based time zones.

Top Three Outcomes for Year One

  • Develop a strong foundational knowledge of all Revinate products and what it takes to implement them from end-to-end.
  • Independently manage 25-35+ new mid-Level Strategic product implementation projects simultaneously. Successfully handle multiple aspects within larger contracts, running between 60-70+ Product Launch Objects.
  • Work closely with internal team members to ensure the efficient and accurate configuration of new accounts within the target 4-8 week implementation period.

What Youll Do

  • Lead the customer implementation process as the primary point of contact, ensuring adherence to the project timeline and a smooth onboarding experience by proactively managing communication of expectations, procedures, and requirements to all internal and external stakeholders.
  • Drive project execution by collaborating with the project team, ensuring the timely completion of key deliverables and milestones, leveraging internal resources efficiently, and escalating risks as necessary.
  • Organize and lead effective internal and external project meetings, including scheduling and preparing necessary supplementary materials.
  • Manage all project documentation, including maintenance, updates, and distribution. Continuously create and refine internal Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to enhance service quality and adapt to evolving product and process changes.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert for Revinates product suite, advising customers on maximizing the value of their services.
  • Commit to continuous learning across all facets of Revinate s products and services, building deep technical expertise related to integrations, software, systems, and product infrastructure.
  • Validate and ensure the correct implementation, integration, and intended functionality of all project technical components.
  • Execute and manage the technical setup and configuration of systems and solutions.
  • Resolve technical product issues encountered during implementation, often requiring hands-on back-end configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Actively pursue professional development, cross-training, and continuous learning to expand product and industry knowledge.
  • Act as a critical liaison between the customer and the internal product team, advocating for customer-requested enhancements to drive product improvement.
  • Perform thorough testing of product functionality and monitor relevant performance metrics, such as email deliverability, prior to project closure.
  • Coordinate with third-party Property Management System (PMS) vendors to acquire necessary technical details for integration.

What You'll Bring

  • Associate s Degree in a related field or a minimum of 2 years of professional experience in a Project Management role. Preference given to candidates with experience in customer-facing SaaS technology, Hotel Operations, or Hospitality Marketing.
  • Demonstrated ability to successfully manage a high volume of simultaneous, ongoing projects and competing priorities (e.g., 50-60+ implementations).
  • Exceptional organizational skills and proven ability to prioritize tasks effectively under tight deadlines.
  • Strong technical aptitude, including the ability to rapidly acquire in-depth product knowledge necessary for diagnosing and resolving technical issues.
  • Experience collaborating with back-end engineering or integration teams to ensure seamless product and system functionality.
  • Proficiency with MS Office Suite; familiarity with Google Workspace (G-Suite), Zendesk / Jira, and Salesforce is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of various project management software and tools (e.g., Asana, Rocketlane).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Practical experience with technical SaaS software configuration and managing integrations.
  • Familiarity with hospitality systems, specifically Property Management Systems (PMS) such as Opera, roomMaster, or Maestro.

People Describe You As

  • A master communicator. You are highly effective at building rapport with customers and internal teams alike. You are a skilled, active listener and an efficient email correspondent, and you understand the value of proactive communication.
  • Flexible and fluid. You excel at managing multiple projects with unique needs, recognizing and applying patterns to drive efficiency. You thrive on finding innovative solutions to challenges as they arise.
  • Highly organized. You possess a methodical approach to work.

jobDescription:
Channel Fusion is building an AI Factory focused on accelerating software delivery, automating business operations, modernizing legacy platforms, and creating intelligent customer-facing solutions through Agentic AI.

This is a hands-on implementation role. Rather than owning a single client program, this person builds and ships AI agents and automation across Channel Fusion's teams and client solutions wherever the Lead AI Platform Engineer and Field Product Managers identify agent opportunities. You'll work day-to-day alongside Suraj (AI Engineer) and under the direction of the Lead/Senior AI Platform Engineer, picking up implementation work as it's scoped and prioritized across programs.

This role does not set agent architecture standards or product requirements those come from the Lead AI Platform Engineer (how) and the relevant FPM (what). This role is the execution capacity that turns those specs into working, production-quality agents.


Role & responsibilities :-

What You Own

  • Implementation Build, test, and ship individual agents and automations to the architecture and standards set by the Lead AI Platform Engineer.
  • Cross-Team Delivery Pick up agent-building work across whichever Channel Fusion team or client solution has current priority, rather than owning one fixed program.
  • Peer Collaboration Work directly with Suraj and other AI engineers to share patterns, reusable components, and avoid duplicated effort across parallel implementations.
  • Quality & Testing — Write and maintain evals/tests for the agents you build so regressions are caught before they reach production.
  • Feedback Loop — Flag gaps, edge cases, or ambiguity in a spec back to the Lead/FPM rather than guessing silently.

Key Responsibilities

Agent Implementation

  • Build agents against specs handed down from the Lead AI Platform Engineer and FPMs — covering planning, tool use, and task execution.
  • Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) components against enterprise knowledge sources.
  • Wire agents into internal and external business systems via secure APIs and data access patterns already established by the platform team.
  • Reuse and extend existing agent frameworks/libraries rather than building one-offs.

Cross-Program Delivery

  • Move across Channel Fusion client programs and internal workflows as implementation priorities shift.
  • Ramp quickly on a new program's data model and requirements with support from the assigned FPM.
  • Keep implementation consistent with patterns used elsewhere in the AI Factory, flagging when a program's needs don't fit existing patterns.

Quality, Testing & Operations

  • Write evaluation/test cases for agents before they ship.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot agents in production; escalate architecture-level issues to the Lead.
  • Track and report token/cost usage for agents you own.

Qualifications Required:-

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Hands-on experience building or shipping at least one production AI-enabled application or agent.
  • Strong Python development skills.
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs.
  • Working SQL skills and comfort with data integration across systems.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Comfort moving across multiple codebases/programs rather than owning a single one.

Preferred — AI & Agentic Frameworks

  • LangGraph, CrewAI, Microsoft Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents Framework, Anthropic APIs, or Azure OpenAI Services.

Preferred — Cloud & Tooling

  • Azure (Functions, AI Services, AKS), Docker, CI/CD pipelines, GitHub Copilot or other AI-assisted development tools.

Preferred — Domain

  • Exposure to channel marketing, co-op advertising, dealer/distributor platforms, or document/PDF-heavy workflows (a current focus area for the team).

descriptionFromApi:
Are you looking to work in the cutting edge area of applying data-science to help global customers get a better insight into their health? If so, read on and apply.


Role Name: Senior Data Scientist

Science Team | Full-Time | In-Office | Bangalore


The Role

The Ultrahuman Science Team builds the algorithms behind the Ring, M1 CGM, blood and urine biomarkers, and Performance Lab assessments. We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to own those algorithms end to end: from the raw sensor signal to a model that is shipped, monitored, and trusted in users' hands.

This is a build role with real scope. In a typical month you will improve a production algorithm, root-cause a metric users are complaining about, and stand up the data pipeline the next model needs. The common thread is ownership: you take a vague question and return a working answer, without waiting to be handed scope.


What You'll Do

  • Own algorithms end to end: sleep staging, activity detection, sensor-derived metrics, and health scores. You frame the problem, build the features, train and evaluate the model, and see it live
  • Ship models, not notebooks: you prove a change on our own cohort before it reaches users, and a model is done only when it runs in production and you can tell how it is behaving
  • Validate against reference standards: design evaluations against gold standards, reference devices, and study ground truth, and know when a result is real and when it is an artifact
  • Own the data layer: cohort extraction, feature pipelines, study data, and raw sensor data, so the next model starts from clean inputs

What This Looks Like in Practice

1. Improving production algorithms - Take an existing production model like sleep staging, root-cause the failure modes against reference data, and ship a fix you can defend with numbers.

2. Building new models - Train an activity classifier on raw sensor data, design the labeled data collection that expands it, and pick the operating point so false positives never erode trust.

3. Proving it before it ships - Run a new steps algorithm against reference-device cohorts, decide with data when it is ready, and monitor how it behaves after rollout.


Who You Are

The two things we can't coach

  • High ownership, end to end: you take a problem from a vague question to a shipped model without waiting to be handed scope, and you can point to something you owned from raw data all the way to production
  • Hungry for more scope: you have outgrown your current role and want problems biggerthan your title, with the technical depth to be trusted with them

Also important

  • You've worked with human health data: wearables, physiological signals, or clinical data.

If your experience is close but not exact, show us why you will ramp fast

  • You've built at a startup: or somewhere small enough that nobody handed you clean data, clear specs, or a mature ML platform
  • You work like it's 2026: coding agents and AI tooling are part of how you build every day, and you can tell which new capabilities are worth adopting
  • You communicate: you can explain a model and its limits to a product manager, an engineer, or a founder, and hold your own with our scientists Core Technical Skills
  • Languages and data: Python and SQL daily, comfortable working in a real codebase
  • Machine learning: PyTorch or TensorFlow, scikit-learn, and gradient boosting, with the judgment to know which the problem needs
  • Advanced machine learning: time series and sequence models, deep learning on continuous physiological signals, and ensembles
  • Statistics and evaluation: hypothesis testing, experiment and A/B design, model evaluation, and error analysis against a reference standard
  • Scale and cloud: Spark or equivalent on large datasets, and AWS, GCP, or Azure
  • Production ML and MLOps: training pipelines, model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and drift detection
  • LLMs and agentic systems: fine-tuning and serving models, building agentic pipelines, and using coding agents to move faster

Experience:

- 4 to 5 years building and shipping machine learning systems. We index on what you have shipped and on trajectory, not the exact number of years; if you are a little earlier but have clearly outgrown your current scope, we want to hear from you.

- Bachelor's or higher in engineering, computer science, statistics, or a related field.


How We Work and Who Thrives Here

- The Science team is small and moves fast, and much of the work has no precedent to copy.

- People do their best work here when they are energized by ambiguity, low on ego, quick to adopt a better idea no matter where it comes from, and comfortable owning something before anyone has told them how. If you need a mature data org, clean labelled datasets, and clear guardrails to thrive, this particular role will not be the right fit, and that is worth knowing up front.


What You'll Gain

  • Ownership of algorithms that hundreds of thousands of people see every morning
  • A dataset most scientists never get to touch: 100M+ nights of sleep and continuous physiological signals at scale
  • Direct collaboration with the engineering, product, and design teams building Ultrahuman

  • Experience building an evaluation or accuracy-measurement harness for an LLM classification or extraction task, including confidence thresholds and iterative tuning.

jobDescription:
About the Role

At Hero Vired, we are building AI-powered learning experiences that redefine higher education and professional upskilling. We are looking for a highly motivated Forward Deployed Engineer (AI/ML) who can work at the intersection of AI, engineering, and business to design, deploy, and scale AI-driven solutions across our products and internal business functions.


As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Data Science, and business stakeholders to understand real-world challenges, rapidly prototype AI

solutions, and deploy production-ready applications using modern AI and Machine Learning technologies. This role requires a combination of strong software engineering skills, practical experience with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and the ability to translate business requirements into scalable AI solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Embed with customers to design, build, and deploy voice AI and search solutions end to end.
  • Scope customer use cases gather requirements, map their data and systems, and define success metrics.
  • Build and deploy voice AI solutions (conversational agents, STT/TTS/telephony pipelines, realtime streaming), and tune them for latency and quality.
  • Design and implement search and retrieval systems (RAG, semantic and hybrid search, re rankers) over customer data and knowledge bases.
  • Own end-to-end delivery: prototype, integrate, deploy, tune, and hand off.
  • Integrate solutions with customer systems (CRMs, telephony, databases, APIs, and webhooks).
  • Debug and optimize deployments in production (latency, accuracy, reliability, and cost).
  • Run POCs and pilots, and iterate rapidly on customer feedback.
  • Serve as the technical point of contact and translate business needs into technical solutions.
  • Feed field learnings back into the core product and build reusable tooling from recurring patterns.
  • Onboard and train customer teams on the deployed solutions.

Requirements

  • Strong hands-on software engineering experience (Python and/or Node.js / TypeScript).
  • Hands-on experience with voice AI speech-to-text, text-to-speech, real-time / streaming audio, telephony, and latency optimization.
  • Experience building search and retrieval systems — embeddings, vector search, RAG, re rankers, and hybrid (semantic + keyword) search.
  • Experience with LLM application development — prompt engineering, tool / function calling, and agent orchestration.
  • Proficiency in REST APIs / GraphQL, and integrating third-party systems (webhooks, data pipelines).
  • Experience with databases (SQL and NoSQL).
  • Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and debugging in production.
  • Solid understanding of system design and architecture.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.

Leadership and Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management — able to run technical conversations with both engineers and business owners.
  • Strong customer-facing presence, with the ability to build trust and manage expectations.
  • Ownership mindset with a bias for shipping and end-to-end delivery.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, rapid iteration, and adapting to each customer's context.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer, solutions engineer, or in implementation / delivery / sales engineering.
  • Familiarity with agent orchestration frameworks (LangGraph, CrewAI, Temporal, Google ADK, or AG2).
  • Familiarity with vector databases and search infrastructure (Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate, Elasticsearch / OpenSearch).
  • Exposure to voice / telephony platforms (Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Telnyx, or similar).
  • Indic / multilingual (Hindi / Hinglish) voice or search experience.
  • Domain background in sales-tech, EdTech, or conversational AI.
  • Experience turning customer deployments into reusable frameworks and tooling.
  • Prior experience in Agile / Scrum environments.
  • Open-source contributions or technical blogging.

descriptionFromApi:
BILLFREE

Growth Engineer


Noida, Sector 63 • On-site • 2-5 years • Full-time


WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS

Every day, lakhs of retail transactions flow through Billfree across apparel, footwear, QSR, electronics, jewellery and more.

Each transaction is a signal. Who the customer is. What they bought. When they’re likely to come back. What would bring them back sooner.

Most of that signal goes unused across the retail industry — and honestly, we haven’t extracted all of it either.

Your job is to build the things that turn those signals into revenue: for our merchants, and for us.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS

Not growth marketing. Not backend engineering. Something in between that most companies don’t hire for.

You’ll find problems, build solutions, ship them fast, measure whether they worked, and either kill them or scale them.


Discover Build Experiment Measure Iterate

You’ll have enough engineering ability to build things yourself, without waiting for a sprint slot. And enough curiosity about the business to pick the right things to build.

WHAT YOU’D ACTUALLY WORK ON

Real examples of problems sitting on our list right now:

  • Merchant activation. A retailer signs up but never runs their first campaign. Why? Find the drop-off, build something that fixes it, measure whether activation moves.
  • AI agents for retail ops. A merchant asks “which customers haven’t visited in 60 days and spend above 5,000?” — and gets an answer, not a dashboard to navigate.
  • Segmentation and lifecycle automation. Build the engine that decides which customer gets which message, when, on WhatsApp — across thousands of stores with very different buying cycles.
  • New products. Some of what we’ll be selling in two years doesn’t exist yet. Take a hunch about where retail is going, build a working version of it, put it in front of merchants, and find out if you were right.
  • Internal leverage. Sales, onboarding and support run on manual work that shouldn’t be manual. Automate it, and the whole company moves faster.
  • Growth surfaces. Interactive calculators, self-serve onboarding, in-product prompts — things that generate qualified interest without a sales rep in the loop.

You won’t do all of these. You’ll pick up whatever is most broken or most valuable at the time.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • 2–5 years of hands-on engineering. You can ship to production without supervision.
  • Strong fundamentals over specific frameworks — we care more about how you think than what you’ve used.
  • A builder’s instinct: you see a problem and reach for a prototype, not a document.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. Most of what you work on won’t arrive as a written spec.
  • Genuine interest in why something matters commercially, not just how it works technically.
  • Willingness to kill your own ideas when the data says so.
  • Curiosity that pulls you outside your current stack.

You don’t need retail or SaaS experience. You do need to be the kind of person who gets restless watching someone do something manually for the fifth time.

HOW WE BUILD

AI is not a side experiment here — it’s part of the daily workflow.

We use Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and similar agents as force multipliers. That means you should be able to:

  • Give an agent enough context and constraints to produce something useful
  • Review, challenge and debug what it produces
  • Use it to move fast through unfamiliar codebases and technologies
  • Know when to stop using it, because deterministic engineering is the better answer

We’re wary of two failure modes: engineers who won’t use AI, and engineers who ship whatever it produces.

STACK

You won’t know all of this. You should be able to pick up most of it.

Backend


Node.js, TypeScript, Express / NestJS, REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven systems

Frontend


React, Next.js, responsive UI

Data


MySQL / PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, data modelling, query optimisation

AI


LLM APIs, function calling, RAG, agents, prompt engineering

Infrastructure


AWS, Linux, Docker, CI/CD, production debugging

THINGS WORTH KNOWING BEFORE YOU APPLY

We’d rather you self-select out now than three months in.

  • Schedule. Monday–Friday in office, Saturday from home. It’s a six-day week. Sundays are yours.
  • Ambiguity is the default. You will regularly be handed a problem, not a solution. If that sounds stressful rather than interesting, this isn’t the role.
  • Cross-functional by force. You’ll talk to sales, ops and merchants. You’ll be on calls that aren’t about code.
  • Some of what you build will be thrown away. That’s the point of experiments. If you get attached to your work, it will hurt.
  • Small team, wide surface area. Real ownership, but also less structure than a larger company.

ABOUT BILLFREE

Billfree Labs builds the post-purchase layer for offline retail.

Retailers already have billing software. It records what happened. We connect to it and help them use what happened — customer profiles, digital bills, loyalty, feedback, Google Reviews, WhatsApp campaigns, retention automation — to influence what happens next.


The bill shouldn’t end the customer relationship. It should start the next one.

We work with [X]+ businesses across India today.

HIRING PROCESS

1. Intro call — 30 minutes, mutual fit.

2. Technical conversation — walk us through something you’ve built end-to-end.

3. Build round — a real problem from our backlog, take-home or paired, your choice.

4. Final round — with leadership, on how you think about problems and outcomes.

We aim to close within two weeks of the first call.

Compensation : depending on experience.

TO APPLY

Send your CV to hr@billfree.in & call us at 9871993509— and one paragraph on something you built because it annoyed you that it didn’t exist.

That paragraph matters more to us than the CV.

At DS Stream, we help global enterprises move beyond AI pilots and build AI at scale. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions across Data Engineering, AI Engineering, Data Science, Generative AI, Agentic AI and AI Platform Engineering.

jobDescription:
Job Description

Shah Equity is building a strategy engine designed to ship 36+ quant strategies per year across crypto and US equities. We need quantitative developers who have actually shipped systems to production not built academic backtests. The team you're joining: a PM with active trading book, a Head of AI Engineering building the agent infrastructure, a Quant Validation Engineer whose job is to break your code, and the founder who personally cares about every strategy that goes live.


Mission

Build, test, and deploy production trading strategies. Partner with traders to algorithmize their edge. Pair with the validation engineer on stress-testing. Ship code that runs unattended with real money.


90-Day Outcomes

  • Ship two production strategies by Day 60
  • Build or extend the backtesting framework (we already have a baseline)
  • Establish documentation and code review practices the team adopts
  • Successfully convert at least one manual trader's strategy into an algorithm

What You Bring

  • 2+ years of production quantitative development experience
  • Strong Python (mandatory). C++ or Rust a plus.
  • Backtesting framework experience you've built one or extensively used one
  • Comfort with execution platforms IB API, Alpaca, Polygon, Binance API, or equivalent
  • Demonstrable strategy you have personally built and tested (not just modified from a tutorial)
  • Statistics fluency you can talk through Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown, walk-forward, and overfitting prevention

How You'll Use AI

  • Daily use of Claude or Cursor for code generation and review
  • AI-assisted backtest analysis and edge case identification
  • LLM-assisted documentation — every strategy you ship has full written documentation
  • Partnership with Head of AI Engineering on the agent layer that orchestrates strategy execution

Compensation

4.5-11 LPA based on profile depth. Performance bonus tied to strategies you ship to production AND their actual P&L. Top performers may receive equity at the operating-entity level on strategies they own end-to-end.


Work Sample (After Initial Screen)

72 hours: build a small backtest of a simple mean-reversion strategy on data we provide. Submit GitHub repository with: code, backtest results, written analysis of the strategy's weaknesses, and your approach to preventing overfitting. We grade on code quality, statistical rigor, and the honesty of your weakness analysis (if you say the strategy is perfect, we know you didn't look hard enough).


Application Instructions (READ CAREFULLY)

Apply by emailing recruiting@shah-equity.com.

Subject line MUST be exactly: [QUANTDEV-2026] Your Full Name — Primary Language

Example: [QUANTDEV-2026] Priya Sharma — Python

In the email body, include exactly three things, numbered:

  • 1. One GitHub or code repository link (must be public or accessible)
  • 2. One strategy you've personally built, in one sentence
  • 3. The most complex bug you debugged in a backtest, in two sentences


Applications that follow these instructions are processed first. The instruction is itself a filter — quant developers who can't follow precise written specs aren't quant developers we want.

  • Develop financial models, cost analyses, benchmarking frameworks, process documentation, and client-ready presentations across GCC advisory and strategy projects

  • GBS / GCC Strategy and Setup: Conduct analysis of operating model options (centralized, federated, hybrid) and build-operate setup models, location and sourcing strategy, GBS guiding principles, and process taxonomy (L0L5) design for new and scaling shared services

  • Operating Model: Support the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of the Operating Model by analyzing processes, roles, governance, and performance metrics to enable efficient service delivery.
  • Cost Analysis and Value Realization: Develop detailed cost models covering setup costs, run-rate costs, and total cost of ownership for GBS and transformation scenarios; build value realization frameworks that track benefit and savings delivery against investment over time, incorporating productivity, quality, and strategic value levers
  • Org Design and Sizing: Design organization structures for the GBS / SSC and retained teams roles, spans and layers, reporting lines, and FTE sizing methodologies
  • SSC Location Strategy: Support location assessment and selection studies across cost, talent availability, risk, and scalability dimensions to recommend best-fit delivery locations for shared services
  • KPI and Performance Frameworks: Design KPI and SLA frameworks for GBS performance management, covering operational, financial, service, and experience metrics; develop dashboards and reporting cadences aligned to governance structures
  • Capability Maturity Assessment: Conduct structured maturity assessments across functions and processes against leading-practice benchmarks; translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines
  • Governance, RACI and Interaction Model Design: Design governance frameworks (councils, decision rights, escalation paths), RACI matrices, and interaction models defining roles and collaboration patterns between the GBS, retained organization, business units, and third-party providers
  • Gen AI in functions: Contribute to assessments and recommendations on Gen AI and intelligent automation use cases across functional processes
Professional Technical Skills:
  • 2-5 years of total experience in GBS consulting, functional transformation or Operating model, advisory, or in-house shared services; experience at a top-tier or Big 4 firm preferred
  • Working knowledge of at least 23 of the following: GBS / GCC / SSC setup, functional operating model design, sourcing location strategy, org design sizing, process maturity assessment, governance interaction model design
  • Ability to build and interpret cost models, TCO analyses, and value realization frameworks and GBS transformation contexts
  • Experience designing KPI and SLA frameworks and performance measurement structures; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
  • Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches capability, process, or operating-model maturity and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
  • Familiarity with core functional processes and process taxonomy frameworks such as the L0L5 process hierarchy
  • Awareness of Gen AI adoption in one or more functions including intelligent automation use cases and their implications for GBS process and workforce design
  • Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills
Additional Information:
  • Opportunity to work on GBS / GCC and operating model programs for marquee G2000 clients across industries
  • Exposure to senior stakeholder engagements and client-facing responsibilities as part of high-performing delivery teams
  • Potential to co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
  • Ability to embed responsible business into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
  • Personalized training modules to develop your strategy consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
  • Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.



Qualification

Driivz, a Vontier company, powers the e-mobility revolution with a market-leading, end-to-end EV Charging and Energy Management platform for global charge point operators and electric mobility service providers.

Key Responsibilities

  • QA Mobile EV features such as charging, site discovery, payments, biometrics, history, profile, notifications etc. across Android (Kotlin), iOS (Swift), and the Driver Portal web flows.

  • Network conditioning (Charles or Proxyman); real-device labs and cloud labs (Firebase Test Lab, BrowserStack, or equivalent).
  • Comfortable testing RESTful APIs and reading mobile network traces — both client- and server-side awareness.
  • Bug triage with clean repro — steps, environment, logs, severity, blast radius. Strong analytical and root-cause skills under pressure.
  • Excellent English communication, both verbal and written.
  • Self-starter, quick learner, comfortable working independently across cross-functional teams.

title: AI Solutions Analyst
jobDescription:
AI Solutions Analyst

Mumbai Office


About the job

At Nouryon, our global team of changemakers takes positive action every day, to reach higher goals collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society's needs today and in the future.

The AI Solutions Analyst is a developer on Nouryon's AI invoice intelligence platform an application that reads supplier invoices and extracts charge-level detail to give the business full transparency into logistics cost. This role owns the end-to-end onboarding of vendors onto the platform analysing each vendor's invoice format, engineering the AI instructions that teach the system to read it correctly, and validating extraction quality until it can be trusted. This role is the connective tissue between the digital transformation team, logistics and procurement stakeholders, and the data that drives cost-leakage decisions — ensuring that AI-extracted invoice data translates into measurable savings, organisational transparency, and continuous improvement.


Job Description

The role is centered around the following core pillars:

  • AI Prompt Engineering – Design, tune and test the natural-language instructions that teach the AI to read each vendor's invoice format accurately.
  • Vendor Onboarding – Own the end-to-end onboarding of new vendors onto the platform, from first sample invoice to live, validated extraction.
  • Data Analytics – Serve as the analytical engine of the team by measuring extraction accuracy, error patterns, and AI processing cost, and translating findings into targeted improvements.
  • Data Quality Assurance – Validate AI output against source documents and safeguard the integrity of the invoice data reaching the business.
  • Stakeholder Management – Coordinate with the digital transformation team, logistics procurement, operations, and vendors to align formats, priorities and expectations.
  • Process Improvements – Identify and deploy improvements in onboarding, extraction, and quality-assurance workflows.

Job Responsibilities

Vendor Onboarding & Format Analysis

  • Collect and analyse representative sample invoices from new vendors across warehouse, ocean freight, road/rail, and customs brokerage modes.
  • Identify each vendor's invoice structure, charge-line conventions, and formatting quirks that affect automated extraction.
  • Onboard vendors onto the platform, configuring extraction profiles and routing settings per vendor.
  • Own a named portfolio of vendors end-to-end, from onboarding through to sustained extraction quality.

AI Prompt Engineering & Model Training

  • Design, write and iterate custom extraction prompts that teach the AI to read each vendor's invoices correctly.
  • Test prompt changes against curated reference sets before releasing them to production.
  • Diagnose extraction failures to root cause and resolve them at the prompt level, permanently rather than case by case.
  • Continuously improve extraction accuracy and reduce AI processing cost per invoice.

Validation & Data Quality

  • Validate AI-extracted charge lines, invoice metadata and classifications against source documents until extraction holds reliably.
  • Approve, correct or reject extracted data, ensuring only verified information reaches downstream reporting.
  • Curate golden test sets from verified invoices to support regression testing.
  • Safeguard data quality, completeness and consistency across the vendor portfolio.

Analytics & Performance Reporting

  • Measure and report extraction accuracy, first-pass approval rate, and AI cost per invoice for owned vendors.
  • Analyse error patterns across vendors, modes and document types to identify systemic improvement opportunities.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for the programme team and senior stakeholders.
  • Prepare periodic performance reporting for leadership.

Stakeholder Engagement & Process Improvement

  • Act as a key interface between the digital transformation team, logistics procurement, operations, and vendors on onboarding and extraction topics.
  • Escalate invoice formats or system limitations that require platform-level changes, with a recommended course of action.
  • Identify and implement process improvements across onboarding, prompt engineering, and quality-assurance workflows.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of analytics, reporting, and decision-support tooling.

We believe you bring (Education & Experience)

This is a specific profile. We are not looking for a generalist analyst — we are looking for someone who has built AI solutions in the field, against real data, with users watching.

1. Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) experience
You have worked embedded with a business function, not behind a ticket queue. You have taken an ambiguous operational problem, built a working solution against real data, and iterated it in front of the people who use it. You are comfortable when requirements arrive as a conversation rather than a specification.

2. Prompting
You have built something with an LLM that worked measurably better on Friday than it did on Monday — and you can explain exactly why. You treat prompts as engineered artefacts: versioned, tested against a reference set, and improved against a number. Experience with structured extraction from documents is a strong advantage.

3. Scrum
You have delivered in sprints — planning, stand-up, demo, retro — in a self-organising team. This team has no team lead: you will pick up work from a prioritised backlog, commit to it, and be accountable for it without being assigned it.

4. SQL and Python (pandas)
Intermediate SQL: joins, aggregations, grouping, window functions. Python at pandas level, sufficient to analyse extraction results offline, compare model outputs across runs, and quantify accuracy. You use data to prove an improvement, not to describe it.

5. Structured problem decomposition
You turn "this vendor extracts badly" into a specific, testable hypothesis, a defined check, and a fix that holds. You look for the systematic cause behind a single error rather than correcting the symptom.

6. Analytical rigour on documents
You can find one wrong figure in a forty-line charge table — and you are still finding it at four in the afternoon. Sustained precision over high volumes of detailed document work is the daily craft of this role.


Nice to have

  • Domain exposure — finance, procurement, logistics or supply chain; invoices, freight, warehousing, customs (Invoice processing, Accounts Payable)
  • Data annotation, labelling or data-quality operations background
  • Palantir Foundry experience
  • Statistical or ML modelling depth beyond descriptive analytics
  • BI tooling — Power BI, Tableau
  • Scrum certification — CSM / PSM
  • Version control — Git fundamentals
  • Experience supporting European stakeholders from an offshore or captive centre

Education & Experience

  • 2 to 8 years of relevant experience in forward deployed engineering, solution delivery, data analytics, or technical consulting.
  • Bachelor's Degree (BA/BS) in Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Supply Chain, Operations Research, or a related field from an accredited institution.
